'''''Arjun Jr.''''' was a [[combat utility vehicle]] launched by the [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruiser]] ''[[Arjun]]'' at the [[Battle of Organarms]] to resupply [[Missile Boat]] ''Mu 1''.
